findings.obs_text: In Psa 139:17 God's thoughts are precious to the psalmist: the thoughts are loved. In Judg 15:2 the father thought Samson hated his daughter: a mistaken thought about love. In Dan 4:19 Daniel's alarming thoughts concern the dream he wishes on those who hate the king, and in 2Cor 12:19 Paul answers what the beloved have been thinking.
findings.grounds: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God

findings.obs_text: In Exo 2:14, Judg 3:24, 1Sa 16:6, 1Sa 20:26 and 2Ki 5:11 surely marks the certainty of the quoted thought, and each time the thought is wrong or overturned: the deed is known, the king is relieving himself, the anointed is before him, he is unclean, the prophet will come out. In Psa 48:9 and Psa 94:18 the thought is set on the Lord's steadfast love, which holds up the one whose foot slips; in 2Ch 32:1 the acts of faithfulness come before Sennacherib's plan, and in Heb 11:11 the one counted faithful is God.
findings.grounds: your steadfast love, O Lord, held me up

findings.obs_text: In Isa 66:18 the Lord who knows their works and thoughts will gather the nations to see his glory: the knowing of thoughts precedes the showing of glory.
findings.grounds: they shall come and shall see my glory

findings.obs_text: In Luk 1:51 the Lord acts with his strong arm against those proud in their inner reasonings: his might is set against proud thoughts. In Ecc 9:10 the hand is to work with might, for there is no thought in Sheol.
findings.grounds: he has scattered the proud in the thoughts of their hearts

findings.obs_text: In Psa 50:21 the Lord was silent and the people thought him like themselves: his silence was taken for sameness. In 2Sa 14:17 the woman thought the king's word would set her at rest. In 1Cor 7:40 Paul thinks she is happier if she remains, and in 1Pe 4:1 the way of thinking to arm oneself with goes with having ceased from sin.
findings.grounds: These things you have done, and I have been silent
